items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: the way the rhythm was so good with Sellers and company, you know The Goon Show.

ctx.x: Yeah it’s called Nixieland music. And this was like our sort of version of a New Orleans revival band that was happening in Britain at that time, Monty Sunshine and Chris Barber and all those guys, Kenny Ball, big hits they had over there, and here too, “Midnight in Moscow” or stuff like that. And so this was about ’57 or ’58. And we had our own little band and we did this same kind of feel, and we played you know like country clubs playing old Gospel music, kind of hymns. “Lord, Lord, Lord you shore been good to…
understanding what they were even saying, but the way the rhythm was so good with Sellers and company, you know The Goon Show. Did you ever hear any of those?
